Monster NVIDIA Reports Results: Global Week Ahead

What happens across this Global Week Ahead?

The world's top central bank chiefs gather in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, against a jittery backdrop

Half a year into the Iran war, and

With bond markets rattled, by a selloff in long-dated U.S. debt, that prompted U.S. Treasury intervention

Away from Jackson Hole, Wyoming, there's plenty else going on, from—

Nvidia's latest earnings report, and

Inflation readings around the world

To a South Korean policy rate decision, and

An Icelandic vote, on whether to revive E.U. accession talks

Next are Reuters' five world market themes, re-ordered for equity traders—

(1) On Wednesday, Nvidia Reports Results

After a rocky few days for tech stocks, investors will get a fresh read on the artificial intelligence spending boom that has helped propel markets ‌to record highs when Nvidia reports second-quarter results on Wednesday.

The chipmaker, whose processors are central to AI development, is widely viewed as a barometer for both AI investment and broader tech sentiment.

Its results could help determine whether enthusiasm for AI remains strong enough to support lofty valuations, after a recent tech selloff driven in part by rising bond yields.

Investors will focus on demand from major cloud providers, whose spending has fueled Nvidia's rapid growth.

Signs that customers are ramping up AI deployments or spending plans could reinforce expectations that the investment cycle still has room to run.

(2) On Wednesday, U.S. Core PCE Data Lands. CPI Data Get Refreshed Elsewhere

The prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz and crude prices grinding higher are adding to concerns about the global inflation outlook.

Brent is headed for a second straight weekly gain and its sixth advance in eight weeks, but it's the surge in refined products that is drawing growing attention as the Northern Hemisphere heads towards the colder months.

European diesel prices have jumped more than 70% since the outbreak of war in February; U.S. gasoline is up 60%.

With refining output curtailed in the Middle East, Russia, East Asia and beyond, energy-driven inflation looks here to stay.

Story Continues

A clearer picture of global inflation is due in the coming days, with data from Australia on Wednesday, and France, Spain and Tokyo on Friday.

Particular focus will fall on the U.S. core PCE reading on Wednesday — expected to print above the Fed's +2% target for the 65th consecutive month.

(3) On Thursday, South Korea's Central Bank Sets Monetary Policy. Rate Hike?

South Korea's central bank meets on Thursday with markets watching for signs that policymakers are ready to follow up July's first rate hike in 3-1/2 years.

Inflation cooled to an annualized +2.8% that month, but still remains above target as demand for AI-related chips continues to support the economy.

Higher borrowing costs could add to pressure on South Korean stocks, still recovering from June's leverage-fueled selloff, while also boosting the won, which has strengthened more than 10% this month.

Governor Shin Hyun Song has signalled a preference for keeping policy tight to contain inflation, suggesting another hike cannot be ruled out.

Elsewhere, Thailand's central bank meets on Wednesday, but with inflation far more subdued, few expect rates to move again this year.

(4) On Friday, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Speaks for the First Time at Jackson Hole

Big-think or red meat?

That's the choice Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh faces as he prepares a keynote address at the Fed's Jackson Hole symposium in Wyoming: expound on his ideas for reforming the central bank, or stick to the nuts and bolts of monetary policy and whether rates are headed higher.

As the gathering kicks off on Thursday, bringing together central bank chiefs from around the world, the audience for his remarks could hardly be more influential.

Warsh has spent his first weeks as chair focusing on long-term structural issues facing the U.S. economy.

But investors, still digesting a bond selloff, are craving a steer about the here and now.

Warsh has been pretty clear he doesn't want to show his hand, but he may find his no-guidance policy becoming a liability.

(5) Icelanders Vote: A Referendum on Whether to Start E.U. Accession Talks

Icelanders head to the polls on August 29th in a referendum on whether to thaw out E.U. accession talks that have been on ice since 2013, when a eurosceptic government put them in the chiller.

It's not a vote on joining the bloc itself. Any eventual deal would still need a second referendum. For now, polls suggest the country is split right down the middle.

At stake are Iceland's rich natural resources, sky-high interest rates, a punishing cost of living costs and, increasingly, security concerns stirred by U.S. interest in neighboring Greenland.

A "yes" vote would reopen thorny talks with Brussels, with fisheries likely the biggest obstacle. A "no" sends the E.U. question back into the deep freeze and dents the bloc's enlargement pitch.

news.Title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on Monolithic Power Stock?
news.Content:
Based in West Palm Beach, Florida, Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (MPWR) is a fabless semiconductor company developing power management solutions for advanced electronics. With a market cap of roughly $64.7 billion, its products include DC-DC and AC-DC converters, power management ICs, MOSFET drivers, current limit switches, and lighting controls.

The company's specialized power-management chips are designed to reduce total energy consumption across servers, artificial intelligence (AI) systems, storage, networking, appliances, and automotive technologies.

More News from Barchart

IonQ vs. Rigetti: The Better Quantum Computing Stock for Long-Term Investors

QQQ is Still in a Negative Gamma Regime. Here's How a 'Put Wall' and Fibonacci Support Could Come Into Play.

Stocks Set to Open Lower as Chipmakers Get Hit, Nvidia Earnings and Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech Awaited

Our exclusive Barchart Brief newsletter is your FREE midday guide to what's moving stocks, sectors, and investor sentiment - delivered right when you need the info most. Subscribe today!

That focus has translated into share-price performance. MPWR stock gained 52.3% over the last 52 weeks, outperforming the S&P 500 Index ($SPX), which gained 18.3% during the same stretch.

Even in 2026, the stock has continued to outshine the index, rising 41.8% year-to-date (YTD) while the broader index gained 11.8%. It has also outpaced its sector by far, as the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) gained 37.2% over the last 52 weeks and 25.1% YTD in 2026.

Higher sales of power-management solutions for AI and servers have powered the stock's rally, with demand gathering pace across data centers. As hyperscalers race to build next-generation compute infrastructure, Monolithic Power's chips are becoming important for delivering the efficient, reliable power that these demanding systems require at scale.

The trend was clear in Monolithic Power's Q2 FY2026 report, released on Thursday, July 30. Enterprise Data revenue surged 164.3% year over year (YOY) to $380.6 million, accounting for nearly 38.8% of total sales.

Moreover, Monolithic Power has since raised its 2026 Enterprise Data growth floor to 130% from 85%, following a sharp acceleration in AI and server demand. Outside Enterprise Data, Communications revenue climbed 78.3% YOY, driven by optical modules and switch-power solutions, adding another source of momentum.

For FY2026 ending in December, analysts expect diluted EPS of $23.35, representing an 82.6% YOY increase. The company has also beaten analyst EPS estimates in three of the last four quarters, which is an encouraging statistic.

Story Continues

Wall Street currently gives the stock an overall "Strong Buy" rating. Among 14 analysts covering the name, 11 have assigned "Strong Buy," two recommend "Moderate Buy," and one suggests "Hold."

Notably, the bullish view has barely changed from three months ago, when 12 analysts also rated the stock a "Strong Buy." The consistency suggests that analysts see durable fundamentals further supporting Monolithic Power's growth trajectory.

Analysts have even raised their price targets, pointing to MPWR's distinctive positioning in the market. On Friday, July 31, Truist Financial analyst William Stein reiterated a "Buy" rating and lifted his price target to $1,889 from $1,805, following Monolithic Power's solid Q2 results and demand outlook.

Needham analyst Quinn Bolton also reiterated a "Buy" rating on Monolithic Power on July 31, raising his price target to $2,000 from $1,750. Such upgrades reinforce MPWR's bullish case.

Against that backdrop, the average price target of $1,830.83 indicates potential upside of 42.5%. Meanwhile, the Street-High target of $2,100 suggests a gain of 63.4% from current levels.

news.Title: 記憶體成提款機！華邦電、南亞科走疲族群一片綠 分析師揭操作策略
news.Content:
美光股價重挫，拖累日韓記憶體股今（25）日持續走弱，台廠也難逃賣壓，包括包括南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）雙雙下挫逾3%，力積電（6770）、群聯（8299）跌幅也達5%。分析師表示，此波下跌主要受到美股修正及個股漲多影響，並非產業趨勢反轉，投資人可採急漲減碼、拉回加碼策略。

輝達財報公布前夕，晶片股賣壓升溫，費城半導體指數24日重挫2.7%。中國記憶體大廠長江存儲申請於科創板上市，預計籌資49億美元，引發市場擔憂記憶體產業競爭加劇，拖累美光股價重挫5.83%，終場收在每股910.43美元。

受到美光重挫及科技股賣壓升溫影響，台股記憶體族群今日遭遇逆風。指標股南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）雙雙挫跌逾3%，截至上午10時15，分別報482元和168.5元。另外，力積電走弱下跌4.8%，報67.4元；群聯也重挫5%，來到2,015元。

先前走勢強勁的記憶體模組廠今日也明顯拉回，包括威剛（3260）、創見（2451）及宜鼎（5289）盤中均重挫逾半根停板；宇瞻（8271）、品安（8088）與十銓（4967）跌幅也超過3%，族群全面陷入整理。

啟發投顧分析師白易弘表示，記憶體族群出現集體回檔，主要受到昨日美股修正、美光走跌，以及美國國債利率與升息預期導致科技股修正的影響。不過，記憶體產業的整體趨勢依舊維持正向發展，近期下跌並非產業趨勢走弱，而是個別股票先前漲多的正常拉回，包括南亞科、華邦電等都出現回測，成為被提款主要對象。

白易弘建議，投資人可以配合營收公布的節奏與股價漲跌，採取逆向操作策略。當記憶體模組廠或南亞科等個股股價急拉往上走時，應進行減碼；而當股價像今日出現拉回時，則可將先前減碼的部位重新加碼買回。

王詩婷／財經特派記者，主跑勞動部、半導體、生技等

news.Title: Bitdeer Chief Strategy Officer Purchases 25,000 Shares at $8.84
news.Content:
Chief Strategy Officer Basit Haris Fozan purchased 25,000 Class A Ordinary Shares of Bitdeer Technologies (NASDAQ:BTDR) at $8.84 per share on Aug. 14, 2026, according to a recent SEC Form 4 filing .

Company snapshot

Market capitalization: $2.1 billion

Trailing 12-month revenue: $812.3 million

Trailing 12-month net income: ($-228.5 million)

Headquarters: Singapore

Bitdeer Technologies Group is a technology enterprise primarily focused on the cryptocurrency mining sector. The company engages in proprietary digital asset mining, extracting cryptocurrencies for its own portfolio, while also delivering comprehensive mining solutions to its community clients.

Key questions

What is the magnitude of this purchase relative to the officer's previous position?

The acquisition of 25,000 shares represents a 250% increase in the insider's direct equity holdings, from 10,000 to 35,000.

What were the market conditions at the time of the trade?

Shares were purchased at $8.84, while the stock was priced at $9.13 as of the Aug. 14, 2026, market close. As of this writing, the stock price has dropped 16.8% over the last 12 months.

Are there other share classes or indirect holdings to consider?

The filing indicates no indirect holdings and no other share classes for this reporting owner; the entire 35,000-share position is held directly through Class A Ordinary Shares.

Company Overview

$9.13

Market Capitalization

$2.1 billion

Revenue (TTM)

Net Income (TTM)

Company Snapshot

Bitdeer Technologies operates a diversified cryptocurrency mining business, generating revenue through its proprietary digital asset mining operations and by providing comprehensive mining solutions to institutional and retail clients.

The company's business model centers on extracting cryptocurrencies for its own portfolio while simultaneously offering end-to-end mining services, including hardware sourcing, logistics management, and operational support across the entire mining lifecycle.

Bitdeer serves a global community of mining clients ranging from individual miners to institutional participants seeking to optimize their cryptocurrency mining operations through the company's integrated technology platform and infrastructure solutions.

Story Continues

Bitdeer Technologies is a Singapore-headquartered technology enterprise with a market capitalization of $2.1 billion. The company has established itself as a significant player in the cryptocurrency mining sector, generating $812.3 million in TTM revenue while managing the complexities of digital asset extraction and the provisioning of mining infrastructure. Despite current profitability challenges, as reflected in a TTM net loss of $228.5 million, Bitdeer maintains a comprehensive competitive position through its vertically integrated approach to mining hardware sourcing, logistics optimization, and proprietary mining technology deployment.

What this transaction means for investors

There are plenty of reasons to sell a stock, but insider buying is notable, particularly at this level. Fozan increased his holdings by 250%, which is extremely bullish activity, especially given that the stock price has sunk 16.1% thus far in 2026. When the company reported revenue for the second quarter of 2026 on Aug. 10, it shared that total revenue increased by $155.6 million from the prior-year period to $228.8 million. It is burning through more money, however, as Bitdeer reported a net loss of $92.3 million for the quarter compared to a loss of $62.9 milion in the prior-year period.

For the Bitdeer stock price, analysts are just as bullish, and Fozan's purchase suggests what could be ahead for the company. Of the 13 analysts who cover Bitdeer and are tracked by CNN, 92% rate Bitdeer stock as a buy. Of those analysts, the median one-year price target is $21, representing a 92.4% gain from today's price. The group's highest price target is $35, and the lowest targets the stock at $10, right around its current price.

Why the China-Led Weakness in NXP Semiconductors Stock Could Open Doors for Speculators
news.Content:
While NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) may be a strong business overall, its recent severe underperformance has left many questions regarding forward viability. Over the trailing month, NXPI stock has lost roughly 19%, thus leading to a very modest year-to-date performance of just under 4%. Fundamentally, the chipmaker — which is heavily exposed to the Chinese auto market — may be facing broader economic challenges. Still, the weakness could offer a contrarian opportunity for bold speculators.

On paper, circumstances would seem optimistic. In the company's second-quarter earnings report, it exceeded headline metrics. According to Google Finance's summary sheet, NXP reported record non-GAAP earnings of $3.61 per share and revenue of approximately $3.50 billion, thus resulting in 19.5% growth year-over-year. Contributing to the strong print were accelerating adoption of software-defined vehicles and expanding physical AI infrastructure applications.

More News from Barchart

Nvidia Stock Is Treading Water Ahead of Earnings This Week - What's the Best NVDA Play?

Option Volatility and Earnings Report For Aug 24-28

Huge, Unusual Put and Call Option Volume in Intel - Investors Bullish as INTC Drops

Markets move fast. Keep up by reading our FREE midday Barchart Brief newsletter for exclusive charts, analysis, and headlines.

Unfortunately, the market was skeptical about the future trajectory of NXPI stock, especially due to auto industry concerns. Analysts raised alarm about global inventory risks stemming from a potential slowdown in China, along with other macroeconomic headwinds. Such anxieties aren't exclusive to NXP, with the wider chip industry experiencing selling pressure.

At the same time, the counterbalancing argument is that China is aggressively transitioning to electric vehicles. This macro tailwind should help lift NXP's semiconductor value per car significantly. Therefore, it's not a foregone conclusion that NXPI stock will be permanently stuck with a technical sell rating.

What's more, the current quantitative structure of NXPI is quite unique. In the last 10 weekly sessions, the ticker has only managed to print two positive candlesticks, leading to an overall downward slope. Under this 2-8-D quantitative sequence (2 up, 8 down, downward slope), the market tends to generate a positive forward bias for NXPI stock.

How much of a bias? Well, there's an inductive reason why I'm looking at the 250/260 bull call spread expiring Oct. 16.

Multiple Presuppositions Battle for NXPI Stock

Story Continues

To be fair, when you look at the forecasted stats for the 250/260 call spread, they don't exactly inspire confidence. For one thing, you would need serious juice for NXPI stock to rise about 15.3% from Friday's close to trigger the second-leg strike price, which would result in a 104.08% maximum payout. However, the current implied volatility (IV) for the Oct. 16 options chain is 42.67%, whereas the historic volatility for the period is 43.61%.

Why is that a problem? IV metrics stem from actual orders. Therefore, if market participants' various transactions imply less-than-historical expectations for share price movement, expecting a move of over 15% over the next eight weeks seems extremely (perhaps unreasonably) optimistic.

In fact, this is a big reason why the probability of profit is listed at 23%. Nominally, there's a very low chance that NXPI stock will hit $254.90 at expiration, let alone the $260 strike. And what about the strike? If you reverse engineer Barchart's Expected Move calculator, you're looking at a probability of only 18.93%.

So the conclusion is rather obvious: if we were to accept the above odds as absolute truth, then the NXPI stock call spread would be completely reckless. The question, though, is whether or not the odds provided are indeed absolute truth?

Here's the harsh reality: from an epistemological framework, we can know absolutely nothing about the unknown future. Even concepts like "before and "after" are presuppositional. Just because these concepts existed throughout deep time does not necessarily mean we can rely on them with absolute certainty.

Now, I'm not going to suggest that "tomorrow" will not come. From a more practical view, at the heart of the above probabilities is the concept of the random walk. For example, the idea that NXPI stock hitting $260 on Oct. 16 representing only an 18.93% chance didn't come out of nowhere. Instead, these are the legitimate odds if, given the initial IV, NXPI incurred Brownian motion (i.e. random trading dynamics) from now until expiration.

My presupposition, though, is that because NXPI stock suffers from a sharply negative order flow balance, it will likely incur a nonrandom journey. Under this framework, I believe the odds — while not particularly "good" — are higher than what would be assumed under random conditions.

Detailing the Inductive Math Behind NXP Semiconductor Stock

The question now becomes, why did I specifically look at the 250/260 bull spread expiring Oct. 16? Essentially, of the rare few times that we've seen the 2-8-D quant sequence flash since January 2019, NXP Semiconductor stock has delivered an impressive upside performance.

By the raw count, the above signal has flashed 12 times on a rolling basis. Of this figure, NXPI stock has exceeded the equivalent of the $260 strike a total of six times at the end of the eighth week (Oct. 16) following the signal materializing on the charts. Granted, we're talking about an extremely small sample size but so far, the observed condition probability of full profitability is 50%.

In other words, if we gamble that this bullish trend were to repeat in the future, the median endpoint expectation on Oct. 16 is a price of around $260. If so, that may be enough to trigger the second-leg strike, thus resulting in a robust payout.

It must be acknowledged, though, that this framework is a matter of inference, not logical necessity. There's no guarantee that NXP Semiconductor stock will reach $260 at expiration. Also, since we're dealing with a limited sample size, it's not possible to have high statistical confidence.

At the same time, I'm not entirely convinced that NXPI stock will undergo a random walk into October. Because the order flow balance is so negative, I'm betting on major players looking at the quantitative weakness of NXPI as a discounted opportunity.

news.Title: Are Computer and Technology Stocks Lagging  Entegris (ENTG) This Year?
news.Content:

Entegris is one of 614 companies in the Computer and Technology group. The Computer and Technology group currently sits at #3 within the Zacks Sector Rank. The Zacks Sector Rank considers 16 different sector groups. The average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups is measured, and the sectors are listed from best to worst.

The Zacks Rank emphasizes earnings estimates and estimate revisions to find stocks with improving earnings outlooks. This system has a long record of success, and these stocks tend to be on track to beat the market over the next one to three months. Entegris is currently sporting a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy).

Within the past quarter, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for ENTG's full-year earnings has moved 9% higher. This signals that analyst sentiment is improving and the stock's earnings outlook is more positive.

Based on the latest available data, ENTG has gained about 70.5% so far this year. Meanwhile, the Computer and Technology sector has returned an average of 15.7% on a year-to-date basis. This means that Entegris is performing better than its sector in terms of year-to-date returns.

Arista Networks (ANET) is another Computer and Technology stock that has outperformed the sector so far this year. Since the beginning of the year, the stock has returned 44%.

Over the past three months, Arista Networks' consensus EPS estimate for the current year has increased 14.2%. The stock currently has a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy).

Looking more specifically, Entegris belongs to the Electronics - Semiconductors industry, which includes 49 individual stocks and currently sits at #38 in the Zacks Industry Rank. This group has gained an average of 27.5% so far this year, so ENTG is performing better in this area.

Arista Networks, however, belongs to the Internet - Software industry. Currently, this 174-stock industry is ranked #75. The industry has moved -4.2% so far this year.

Investors interested in the Computer and Technology sector may want to keep a close eye on Entegris and Arista Networks as they attempt to continue their solid performance.

news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-24 17:08:13 數位內容中心 發佈

中國A股今(24)日收盤震盪走弱，主要指數全面收低。上證指數收於3,882.01點，下跌0.59%，日K翻黑；深證成指收於13,794.29點，下跌2.13%；創業板指收於3,431.89點，下跌3.21%；科創50收於1,602.34點，下跌3.10%。盤勢偏弱，熱門題材退潮，市場風險偏好明顯降溫。

創業板指跌幅居主要指數之首，算力硬體、半導體、通訊設備等族群承壓，拖累創業板指、科創50表現。中際旭創、新易盛、天孚通信、德福科技與共進股份等個股跌勢明顯，電子、醫藥生物與建築材料等類股也同步走弱。

相較之下，煤炭、銀行、農業與保險等族群相對抗跌，盤中一度成為資金避風港。煤炭類股震盪走強，銀行與農林牧漁相關方向也獲得關注，顯示市場資金轉向高股息與低估值標的。

此外，種業概念表現最強，登海種業漲停，神農種業、國投豐樂、隆平高科等跟漲。黃金概念同樣活躍，白銀有色、深中華A漲停。
